lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a semi-regular lattice posterior to the gill region. The most prominent cluster consists of a 4x5 grid of spots between the primary lateral ridges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a distinct grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible; the primary ridge bisects the flank longitudinally, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition with higher intensity on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated along the basal and posterior regions.

other_distinctive_markers: A secondary elongated silhouette is visible attached to the ventral-lateral region near the insertion point of the right pectoral fin, consistent with a commensal organism.
